DARV.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0-0.ancien: Oh! Didn't hear ya come in. Here, take a gem, take two, they're just gatherin' dust in that pile.
DARV.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0-1.char: Oh, keep the gems! It's that crusty crate of green salt behind you I'm after.
DARV.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0-2.ancien: Ha! That ol' thing went rotten years back. Take the whole crate, would ya? It's been stinkin' up my nice pile.
DARV.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0-3.char: [sine]Rotten?[/sine] Even better! Rotten is halfway to something new.
DARV.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.1-0.ancien: Back already? Ha! Go on then, what're ya diggin' for this time?
DARV.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.1-1.char: Anything that hums, oozes, or smells wrong. Do you have a corner for that?
DARV.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.1-2.ancien: Ha! Friend, that's the whole pile. Take somethin' and don't tell me what it was.
DARV.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.2-0r.ancie: Ya never take the shiny ones. Always the cracked, the corroded, the spoiled. ...Why's that, eh?
DARV.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.2-1r.char: Shiny ones are finished. Cracked ones are still deciding what to be. ...You've kept every one of those, haven't you?
DARV.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.2-2r.ancie: ...Huh. Whole fortune of maybes, and here I've been callin' it a mess.
NEOW.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0-0.ancien:
[sine]..up you get... little alchemist...
..you fell.. such a long way...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0-1.char: Ow. Well, everything hurts, so I'm alive. Good start. ...Sorry, have we met?
NEOW.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0-2.ancien:
[sine]..many times.... ..he unmakes you.. at the summit...
..I remake you.. at the roots...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0-3.char: [sine]Remade! Not a seam on me. You do lovely work. ...Right. Up we go, I've got samples to collect.[/sine]
NEOW.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.1-0.ancien:
[sine]..down again... ..and up again...
..you always find your way back to me...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.1-1.char: 'Again'? ...Oh. You remember the ones I don't. How many? ...No, don't tell me. Bad for morale.
NEOW.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.1-2.ancien:
[sine]..I keep every ending... ..you keep none...
..it is kinder this way...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.2-0r.char: Everyone else dreads starting over. Me, I get a fresh batch every time! ...Shame I never write down the recipe.
NEOW.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.2-1r.ancie:
[sine]..then fall... ..and I will catch you...
..climb... ..and I will send you...[/sine]
NONUPEIPE.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0-0.a:
A frog, in my halls? How novel.
Come forward, little brewer. Wear some luck. You will need it where you are going.
NONUPEIPE.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0-1.c: Luck! I've tried bottling it. It keeps turning into vinegar. Does yours come in a jar?
NONUPEIPE.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0-2.a: It comes from me, and only from me. Now go and be surprising.
NONUPEIPE.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.1-0.a: The dice remember you, little brewer. They so rarely bother. Roll again.
NONUPEIPE.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.1-1.c: I worked out the odds of getting back here. Dreadful! So I stopped counting and walked.
NONUPEIPE.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.1-2.a: One who ignores the odds. Rarer than my blessings.
Every roll has fallen your way. Luck is a fickle thing. What happens the day it doesn't?
Then I finally get to see what that looks like! I've been curious.
You would thank the dice for ruining you. ...I think I like you.
OROBAS.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0-0.anci: Try this!!! Very good finds!! Look, look!!
OROBAS.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0-1.char: Ooh, every color at once! You look like a very good potion. May I lick you? For science.
OROBAS.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0-2.anci: No lick!! Take shiny instead!! Take, take!!
OROBAS.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0-3.char: Fine, fine. Shiny it is. Thank you, you wonderful thing.
OROBAS.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.1-0.anci: Color friend!! You came back!! New shiny for you!!
OROBAS.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.1-1.char: I keep trying to name your colors and running out of words. That never happens to me!
OROBAS.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.1-2.anci: Hehe!! More colors than words!! I win!!
OROBAS.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.2-0r.anc:
I give and give!! You never give back!!
...Is fine. I like giving.
OROBAS.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.2-1r.cha: Oh! Here, take this. It turns blue when someone nearby is lying.
OROBAS.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.2-2r.anc:
BLUE?? Hehe!! Now I know everything!!
Best friend!! Take extra shiny!!
PAEL.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0-0.ancien: [thinky_dots]Welcome, friend. Take a piece of me... it will help you...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0-1.char: Everything else up here bites first. You just... hand bits over? Thank you! I'll take good care of it.
PAEL.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0-2.ancien: [thinky_dots]It is freely given... spend it well...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.1-0.ancien: [thinky_dots]You came back... there is always more of me to give...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.1-1.char: Doesn't it worry you? Piece by piece, until there's nothing left?
PAEL.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.1-2.ancien: [thinky_dots]There is no nothing... only what comes after...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.2-1r.char: Just thinking. You give without measuring. I measure everything twice and still spill it.
PAEL.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.2-2r.ancie: [thinky_dots]Then set down the scales... and simply give...[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0-0.ancien: YOU! LITTLE GREEN ONE! GROW STRONGER SO WE CAN FIGHT!!!
TANX.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0-1.char: Stronger? I have a dose for that! ...And one that does the opposite. I forget which is which.
TANX.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0-2.ancien: HAHAHA!! A GAMBLE!! I LIKE YOU!! TAKE A WEAPON, JUST IN CASE!!
TANX.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.1-0.ancien: YOU RETURN!! LITTLE FROG!! ARE YOU STRONGER YET?!
TANX.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.1-1.char: Stronger AND sicker! I keep dosing myself to see which one wins.
TANX.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.1-2.ancien: HAHAHA!! LET THEM FIGHT!! THE WINNER FIGHTS ME!!
TANX.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.2-1r.char: I'd win, you know. Slowly. You'd feel wonderful right up until you didn't.
TANX.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.2-2r.ancie: ...HAHAHA!! A SLOW DEATH IS STILL A GLORIOUS DEATH!! TAKE THIS, YOU CREEPY LITTLE FROG!!
TEZCATARA.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0-0.a: Oh, do come in, dear, out of that draft. Now then, what can old Tezcatara do for you?
TEZCATARA.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0-1.c: They say you take the things folk would rather not carry. Regrets, old flaws, that sort of thing. True?
TEZCATARA.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0-2.a: Every last one, sweetling. Hand them here, and let me [jitter][b]burn[/b][/jitter] them all clean for you.
TEZCATARA.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0-3.c: [sine]Some of them. Not all. I've grown rather fond of a few.[/sine]
TEZCATARA.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.1-0.a: Back so soon, dearie? What brings you? Come, warm those cold little hands.
TEZCATARA.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.1-1.c: The company, mostly. Everything else up here wants to eat me. You just want to feed me.
TEZCATARA.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.1-2.a: Then sit, little spark, sit. A fire keeps better company than most folk ever managed.
You alchemists. Always [jitter][b]burning[/b][/jitter], distilling, purifying, same as me. You'd have made a darling apprentice.
Flattery! I'll take it. And the fire, if you're offering. Cold climb from here.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0: So there IS a top. And you're what holds it up? Huh.
I'm surprised you reached me. Few do.
Fascinating. I'd like a sample. Hold still...
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.1: Again? You have climbed my Spire twice now.
The last sample spoiled on the way down. Hold still, I need a fresh one.
Sample all you like. Nothing here is true. I built every stone of it.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.2: The alchemist returns. You always look so [sine]pleased[/sine] up here.
Wouldn't you be? Everyone else gets one go. I get to repeat the experiment until I understand you!
You never will. That is rather the point of me.
Then I'll keep trying! Once more, from the top.
VAKUU.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0-0.ancie: Cooking poison in your own veins. Why suffer for scraps? Sign here, and I'll show you [sine]real[/sine] power.
VAKUU.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0-1.char: Tempting! But borrowed power is just a loan with teeth. I'll keep suffering, thanks.
VAKUU.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.0-2.ancie: They all say that. First taste is [jitter][b]free[/b][/jitter], alchemist. For when you get desperate.
VAKUU.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.1-0.ancie: Still no signature. So what do you keep sniffing around for?
VAKUU.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.1-1.char: You, mostly! I like to know what a thing is made of before I take it. Hold still, this won't hurt.
VAKUU.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.1-2.ancie: [sine]Made of[/sine]? I am not [sine]made[/sine] of anything, alchemist. I am what the making [jitter][b]costs[/b][/jitter].
VAKUU.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.2-0r.anci: You poison yourself daily and call [sine]me[/sine] the demon. That's rich.
VAKUU.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.2-1r.char: Mine comes with a label! Yours doesn't. That's the whole difference.
VAKUU.talk.ALCHEMIST-ALCHEMIST.2-2r.anci: ...Fine print's just a formality. But I'll admit, you'd read it. Pity.
